item.title: Summary of Teaching Roles and Responsibilities
item.description: Instructor of record Laboratory in Justice Data Science Term: Spring 2026 Lead Instructor: Me! Course Details: This course, which was taught to incarcerated individuals at Sing Sing Correctional Facility, was both an introductory data analysis course and a discussion seminar to discuss issues at the intersection of human behavior, data science, and public policy. Students completed weekly readings about the implications of data science and technology for society as well as data-heavy reports on issues related to justice.

item.title: Teaching feedback
item.description: Included on this page is student feedback from five courses: Research Methods: Data Science, Justice, and Social Change; developed course and was instructor of record (Fall 2025) Psychology and the Internet; developed course and was instructor of record (Fall 2024) Research Methods: Social Cognition and Emotion; lab section instructor/TA to Professor Kevin Ochsner (two sections in Fall 2022 and one section in Spring 2022) Research Methods: Social and Personality; lab section instructor/TA to Professor Niall Bolger (Spring 2021, on Zoom during COVID-19) I divide my feedback into two sections, based on feedback topic.
